evidence.reason: The current tip already wires `options.signal` to the ssh child. In `src/ops/review/internal/queueClient.ts` the transport registers an `abort` listener (`signal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })`), and `onAbort` clears the timer, removes the listener, SIGKILLs the child, and rejects with `signal?.reason ?? new Error('queue delivery unknown: aborted')`. It also handles an already-aborted signal (`if (signal?.aborted) onAbort()`) and removes the listener on timeout, `error`, and `close`. This is precisely the behavior the finding says is missing, and the history includes commit 3c6a1bbed92edf2089862177bb3e7b856f85b2a3 "fix(review): Kill the in-flight queue ssh child on caller abort".
